slides.title: Computer Networks
content: A computer network is an interconnection of multiple devices (nodes) such as computers, servers, routers, and switches
These devices communicate using communication links like wired cables or wireless signals
It enables data sharing, resource sharing, and communication between devices
Networks support applications like email, web browsing, cloud computing, and video streaming

slides.title: Evolution of Networks
content: 1950s: Concept of sharing computational resources between mainframe systems
1969: ARPANET introduced as the first packet-switching network
1970s: Ethernet technology enabled local area networking
1980s: TCP/IP protocols standardized communication across networks
1990s+: World Wide Web and wireless technologies expanded global connectivity

slides.title: Data Communication
content: Data communication is the exchange of data between two or more devices through a transmission medium
Delivery ensures data reaches the correct destination device
Accuracy ensures the transmitted data is free from errors
Timeliness ensures data arrives within the required time for real-time applications
Low jitter ensures minimal variation in packet delay for smooth communication

slides.title: Components of Communication System
content: Message is the information being transmitted such as text, images, audio, or video
Sender is the device that generates and sends the data like a computer or smartphone
Receiver is the device that receives and processes the data
Transmission medium is the path used to transfer data such as twisted pair cable, fiber optics, or wireless signals
Protocol is a set of rules like TCP/IP that governs data transmission and communication

slides.title: Data Representation
content: Text data is represented using character encoding systems such as ASCII or Unicode
Numbers are represented in binary format for efficient processing by computers
Images are represented as pixels where each pixel stores color information
Audio is represented as digital signals using sampling techniques
Video is represented as a sequence of image frames transmitted over time

slides.title: Transmission Modes
content: Simplex mode allows data transmission in only one direction where one device acts as sender and the other as receiver
Half-duplex mode allows both devices to send and receive data but not at the same time
Full-duplex mode allows simultaneous data transmission in both directions for real-time communication
These transmission modes define how communication occurs between devices in a network
